proc isProbablePrime(n: BigInt; rounds = 12): bool {.
    ...raises: [Exception, ValueError, OSError], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Miller-Rabin with trial division pre-screen. The first rounds use small deterministic bases (2, 3, 5, ...), the rest random bases. With trial division + 12 rounds the error is far below 2^-80 for >= 256-bit candidates (HAC 4.4); randomPrime passes its own round count through.

    ...raises: [ValueError, OSError, Exception], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Generate a random bits-bit prime (top bit + odd enforced). Miller-Rabin rounds run on the Montgomery fast path, so 1024-bit RSA keygen takes ~30ms and 2048-bit ~1s on a laptop.
